paragraphs: R. Chiyya the Tall, of Difti, in Rav Chisda's time. Shabbat, chapter 1, 10a: R. Chiyya bar Rav of Difti taught Rav Chisda and Rabbah bar Rav Huna. The word “the Tall” here in Yuchasin is a scribal error and should read “bar Rav of Difti.” Alternatively, something is omitted here: “R. Chiyya the Tall,” whom I will discuss immediately below, followed by “R. Chiyya of Difti,” who is bar Rav of Difti. Yoma 81b: Chiyya bar Rav of Difti taught. He taught Rav Bivi bar Abaye: Berakhot 8b, beginning. He said to Rav Pappa: Bava Batra 10a. He taught: Shabbat 142b; Pesachim 68b; Rosh Hashanah 9a; Yevamot 74a.
